in_arabic.name: راية
in_arabic.long_meaning: راية هو اسم علم مؤنث، مشتق من كلمة 'راي' والتي تعني 'العلم' أو 'العلامة'. في الإسلام، يُستخدم هذا الاسم للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يحمل رسالة أو علامة دينية. كما يمكن أن يعني 'راية' الشخص الذي يتمتع بالرشاد والهداية.

in_urdu.name: رایا
in_urdu.long_meaning: رایا نام کا مطلب علامت یا دليل سے ہے۔ یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے جہاں 'راي' کا مطلب ہوتا ہے 'علم' یا 'علامت'۔ اسلامی روایت میں، یہ نام اس شخص کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو دینی علامت یا روشنائی کا داعی ہوتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: राया
in_hindi.long_meaning: राया नाम का अर्थ चिह्न या प्रतीक से है। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है जहां 'राय' का अर्थ होता है 'वह व्यक्ति जो मार्गदर्शन प्रदान करता है'। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम उस व्यक्ति के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो धार्मिक ज्ञान और मार्गदर्शन का स्रोत होता है।

in_english.name: Raya

Historically, it has been used across various Muslim cultures, reflecting its importance in Islamic heritage.

data.cultural_impact: The name Raya carries a strong cultural significance in the Muslim community, with its origins tracing back to the Arabic language. In various Muslim countries, such as Indonesia, Malaysia, and Brunei, the name Raya is popular, and it is often associated with joy, happiness, and radiance. The name is commonly given to girls born during the Islamic month of Syawal or the Malay month of Sawal, which roughly correlates to October in the Gregorian calendar. The period is marked by the celebration of Hari Raya Puasa or Eid ul-Fitr, which marks the end of Ramadan, the month of fasting. Hari Raya Puasa is a time of joy, reunion with family, and forgiveness, with many Muslims dressed in new clothing and performing the Eid prayer while also enjoying traditional delicacies and visiting relatives and friends.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Raya holds deeper significance beyond just its literal meaning. In Islamic tradition, the name is believed to signify the inner light, or "Noor," that every human being possesses. This inner light is a reflection of Allah's light, and one of the names of Allah is Al-Nur, which means the Light of the Universe. The name Raya, with its radiant and shining meaning, serves as a constant reminder of the spiritual potential within every person. Moreover, the joy and happiness associated with the name and the festival of Hari Raya Puasa can be seen as symbolic of the spiritual state achieved through leading a virtuous life and adhering to Islamic teachings, as described in the Hadith, where the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) said: "Whoever believed in Allah and His Messenger, and then believed, and (loved to) spread among those who came after him, (Belief) which he in the first instance and which he spread (among men), he will be dwelling in the garden of pleasure under the shade of the Throne of Allah; and Allah the Most High will be pleased with him." (Muslim, 4440) Thus, the name Raya, when given to a child, serves as a constant reminder of their spiritual potential and the importance of leading a virtuous life in order to attain spiritual pleasure and Allah's satisfaction.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Raya was a Persian princess who was the wife of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). The name Raya carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Raya was a Persian princess who was taken as a war booty during the Battle of Khaybar. She was given to Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) as a gift and he married her. She is believed to have converted to Islam before her marriage.
